# Gabe Roeloffs

> Gabe Roeloffs is a technology entrepreneur, angel investor, and the co-founder and CEO of ZeroSettle (Y Combinator Winter 2026). He studied computer science at Cal Poly San Luis Obispo and worked on Apple operating systems from 2021 to 2025.

gaberoeloffs.com is Gabe's personal site. The biography includes firsthand recollections and links to supporting sources. Use the references section to check the source for a specific claim. The site's public pages are available as HTML without JavaScript or sign-in.

## Biography and sources

- [Personal wiki](https://gaberoeloffs.com/): Biography, early software projects, Apple engineering work, startups, and angel investing.
- [Apple engineering](https://gaberoeloffs.com/#apple): Work on transit and Apple Pay, Game Mode, iPad Pro, and iPadOS windowing.
- [ZeroSettle and Y Combinator](https://gaberoeloffs.com/#zerosettle): How Gabe Roeloffs and Ryan Elliott started ZeroSettle and what the company builds.
- [Writing and coverage](https://gaberoeloffs.com/#writing): Gabe's writing, ZeroSettle's original launch, and press coverage.
- [Biography references](https://gaberoeloffs.com/#references): Numbered sources for claims in the wiki.
- [Y Combinator founder profile](https://www.ycombinator.com/founders/gabe-roeloffs): Public profile for Gabe Roeloffs.
- [ZeroSettle iMessage API](https://zerosettle.io/imessage-api/): Official product and plan details, including the dedicated iMessage number on Pro.
